$doc: Pipeline registry. The ONLY place where {codec, cnn, demosaicer} triples are named. Run-gate refuses to test a pipeline that isn't here. Use the full name in artifact paths, PR descriptions, and claims_log.md — never an ad-hoc short form like 'ML2_q3_CNN' (the short form was the failure mode this scaffolding exists to fix).
$naming: codec=<codec_id>+cnn=<cnn_id>+demosaic=<demosaic_id>. Hyphens within an id are fine; '+' separates the triple. If a field is absent (e.g. no CNN), use 'none' (codec=sl_q3+cnn=none+demosaic=sips).
$rules: Adding a pipeline: required fields populated, no ad-hoc 'TODO' fields.
Renaming a pipeline: forbidden in same PR as an artifact run. Rename + re-run in separate PRs.
If you can't fill `cnn_ckpt_sha256`, you can't register the pipeline. Run `sha256sum` on the .pt file.

sips_via_gpr_tools.$doc: Bayer plane → DNG via gpr_tools (Adobe DNG SDK preserves color matrix from source DNG params) → PNG via macOS sips (Apple's CIRawFilter). Gold standard for color science. Requires source DNG for color matrix.

sl_q3.$doc: Single-level FUSED q=3. The shipping stills codec.

sl_q0.$doc: Single-level FUSED q=0 (Low). Smallest files; covers low-bitrate-stills regression.

sl_q5.$doc: Single-level FUSED q=5 (Filmscan-2 / quality peak). Higher fidelity than q=3.

sl_q8.$doc: Single-level FUSED q=8 (Filmscan-5 / archival). Largest files among shipping presets.

ml2_q3.$doc: 2-level FUSED q=3. Restored 2026-05-25. NOT yet shipping for any class.

ml3_q3.$doc: 3-level FUSED q=3. NOT shipping; documented Nyquist regression.

ml3_q12_l1l2x4_legacy.$doc: Historical pipeline that produced the 'looked much better' results in /Volumes/OWC_8TB/gpr_artifacts/visual_compare_20260525/. ml3 codec with L1+L2 highpass cranked 4x. Paired with cnn=bibo1x_ane_l1l2x4. The historical q=12 quality table no longer exists; we approximate via GPR_QUANT_OVERRIDE.
ml3_q12_l1l2x4_legacy.$note: Reproduces the cranked-highpass distribution the L1L2x4 CNN was trained against.

ml2_q3_l1soft.$doc: Experiment E1: ML-2 with L1 highpass quant halved. Tests if visible blockiness is dominated by L1 highpass loss.

ml2_q3_l2soft.$doc: Experiment E2: ML-2 with L2 highpass quant halved. Tests if L2 highpass aliasing causes the blockiness.

ml2_q3_bothsoft.$doc: Experiment E3: ML-2 with BOTH L1 and L2 highpass quant halved.

ml2_q3_nohighpassquant.$doc: Experiment E4: ML-2 with ALL highpass set to quant=1 (effectively no quant). Upper bound on what the ML-2 wavelet can produce. If THIS fails, the wavelet itself is the issue.

ml2_q3_ll2div8.$doc: Experiment E5: LL2 extra divisor reduced from 16 to 8 — more LL2 fidelity.

ml2_q3_ll2div4.$doc: Experiment E5b: LL2 extra divisor = 4. May exceed rANS class-15 ceiling for some content; gate will tell.

ml2_q3_combo.$doc: Experiment E6: lighter L1+L2 highpass + lighter LL2 divisor combined.

ml2_q3_prefilter3h.$doc: Experiment E7: 3-tap horizontal LP prefilter on LL1 before L2 cascade. Attacks horizontal-direction Nyquist aliasing in the L2 wavelet.

ml2_q3_prefilter3h_softq.$doc: Experiment E7b: prefilter + lighter highpass quant. Stacked best-known mitigations.

ml2_q3_prefilter3hv.$doc: Experiment E12: 3-tap LP prefilter in BOTH X and Y on LL1 → L2. Strongest anti-alias.

sl_q3_dec2.$doc: Single-level FUSED q=3 with 2x2 decimation — half-res capture. Output is 1/4 the pixels. Designed for embedded capture; pair with a 2x super-res CNN on the desktop to restore full resolution.

ml2_q3_dec2.$doc: 2-level FUSED q=3 with 2x2 decimation. Half-res capture, 1/4 pixels. The Pi 5 sustained-24-fps capture mode (24.93 fps median measured 2026-05-26). Pair with a 2x super-res CNN on the desktop.

ml2_q3_prefilter3hv_softq.$doc: Experiment E13: H+V prefilter + lighter highpass quant.

gpr_tools_legacy.$doc: Legacy single-level VC5 encoder invoked via the gpr_tools production CLI. Different bitstream from FUSED sl_q3. NOT exercised by run_gate.py — has its own runner: tests/quality_gates/run_gate_gpr_tools.py

ml2_q3_hh1x2.$doc: ml2_q3 with HH1 quant doubled (144→288). Drops just the diagonal high-freq band; matched CNN should restore.

ml2_q3_hh1x4.$doc: ml2_q3 with HH1 cranked 4× (144→576). q=11 ships HH1=576; this isolates the HH1 contribution.

ml2_q3_l1x2.$doc: ml2_q3 with all L1 highpass doubled (LH1/HL1: 96→192, HH1: 144→288).

ml2_q3_l1x4.$doc: ml2_q3 with all L1 highpass 4× (LH1/HL1: 96→384, HH1: 144→576). Same as q=11 single-side except not changing L2.

ml2_q3_l2x2_l1x2_hh1x2.$doc: ml2_q3_l2x2_l1x2 with an additional 2× crank on the L1 HH band (the highest-frequency slot). Hypothesis: HH is the most quantization-tolerant band when paired with the unmatched ml2_q3 CNN; cranking it on top of the proven smallest tier (l2x2_l1x2) should land near 6.5 MB. Slots: 4/5: 48, 6: 24, 7/8: 192, 9: 576.

ml2_q3_l2x2_l1x4.$doc: L2 doubled, L1 4×. Roughly q=11-equivalent in L1, q=3 + 2× L2.

ml2_q3_l2x2_l1x2_hh1x4.$doc: ml2_q3_l2x2_l1x2 with HH1 (slot 9) cranked another 4× from baseline (144→1152). Builds on the smallest-current tier; intended only for the heavy-decoder (Restormer-class) experiment branch.

ml2_q3_l2x2_l1x4_hh1x4.$doc: Most-aggressive desktop-only target: l2x2_l1x4 plus HH1 4× (576→1152 in slot 9). Hypothesis: only a Restormer-class post-RGB filter can recover this; in-distribution BIBO_1x has been shown to fail on the lighter l2x2_l1x4 variant.

ml2_q3_l1x3.$doc: ml2_q3 with L1 highpass ×3 (LH1/HL1: 96→288, HH1: 144→432). Between l1x2 (PASS) and l1x4 (FAIL).

ml2_q3_hh1x8.$doc: HH1 ×8 alone (144→1152). HH is the most-CNN-stubborn highpass.

ml2_q3_l1x2_hh1x4.$doc: Stack: l1x2 ×2 PLUS HH1 cranked 4× (LH1/HL1: 192, HH1: 576).

sl_q3_hh1x4.$doc: SL q=3 with HH ×4 (12→48). Matches q=11's HH.

sl_q3_hh1x8.$doc: SL q=3 with HH ×8 (12→96). Push beyond q=11.

sl_q3_l1x2.$doc: SL q=3 with all L1 ×2 (LH/HL: 24→48, HH: 12→24).

sl_q3_l1x4.$doc: SL q=3 with all L1 ×4 (LH/HL: 96, HH: 48). Roughly q=11.

sl_q3_l1x4_hh1x8.$doc: SL with LH/HL ×4 + HH ×8 (push HH harder than q=11)

gpr_tools_q3.$doc: Legacy CineForm VC5 encoder via gpr_tools CLI, explicit q=3. The codec that ALL CineForm GPR files use (CineForm Filmscan-1 default). Different bitstream from FUSED sl_q3 — uses CineForm's efficient LL coding rather than the FUSED GPR_INCLUDE_LL=1 byte-stuff. Empirically 7.8 MB on Z8 50MP vs FUSED's 17.8 MB at same q.

gpr_tools_q8.$doc: Legacy CineForm VC5 encoder at q=8 (Filmscan-5, archival quality). Larger files (~16 MB on Z8 50MP) than q=3 (7.8 MB) but higher fidelity. Designed for the 'highest quality STILL alternate' ship class. Pi 5 encode: ~1972 ms (best of 3).

gpr_tools_q0.$doc: Legacy CineForm VC5 at q=0. Smaller files than q=3 (3.2 MB vs 7.8 MB on Z8 50MP). Used to test whether the q=3-matched CNN generalizes downward.

gpr_tools_q1.$doc: Legacy CineForm VC5 at q=1. Smaller files than q=3 (3.8 MB vs 7.8 MB on Z8 50MP). Used to test whether the q=3-matched CNN generalizes downward.

gpr_tools_q2.$doc: Legacy CineForm VC5 at q=2. Smaller files than q=3 (5.9 MB vs 7.8 MB on Z8 50MP). Used to test whether the q=3-matched CNN generalizes downward.

none.$doc: No CNN — codec output is the final result.

bibo1x_ane_sl_q3.$doc: BIBO_1x_AAon_w16 trained on SL q=3 codec outputs. The shipped repo checkpoint.

bibo1x_ane_l1l2x4.$doc: Trained against multi-level codec with L1+L2 highpass cranked 4x. Historical 'looked much better' pipeline.

bibo1x_ane_hh1x4.$doc: Trained against sl_q3_hh1x4: single-level q=3 with HH1 cranked 4x via GPR_INCLUDE_LL=1 + GPR_QUANT_OVERRIDE=3:48.

bibo1x_ane_sl_q3_strong5.$doc: Same checkpoint as bibo1x_ane_sl_q3 but applied with 5x residual_scale (0.05). Tests whether the CNN's correction direction is right but undershoot.

bibo1x_ane_ml2_q3.$doc: BIBO_1x retrained on ML-2 q=3 codec output pairs. Awaiting training; ckpt_path will land once train finishes. trained_against_codec: ml2_q3.

bibo1x_ane_ml2_q3_msssim.$doc: BIBO_1x retrained on ML-2 q=3 with MSSSIM_LOSS_WEIGHT=0.3. Directly optimizes the metric that blocked the L1-only retrain on Z8Z_6693.

bibo1x_ane_ml2_q3_mu_law.$doc: BIBO_1x retrained on ML-2 q=3 with --loss-domain mu_law (Hanji et al. SIGGRAPH Asia 2024, arxiv 2312.03640). msL1 applied to mu_law(pred) vs mu_law(target) with mu=5000. Tests T2 of overnight plan 2026-05-28: does perceptual-domain L1 beat linear L1 on our regime? Training halted at ep 3 (gain +1.607 dB, plateaued) to free MPS for T1 (higher-EV BIDO-with-OOD test).

bibo2x_ane_sl_q3.$doc: BIBO_2x super-res: half-res bayer in, full-res bayer out. Architecture: F_ane (sr2x=True). Pair with a half-res codec like ml2_q3_dec2 — this is the historical 'embedded capture + desktop super-res' pipeline.

bibo2x_ane_ml2_q3_dec2.$doc: BIBO_2x super-res CNN trained on matched ml2_q3_dec2 codec outputs. Half-res bayer in, full-res out. Trained on M5 (200 Z8 DNGs → 8000 tiles, val=Z8Z_0067, 80 epochs, best at ep73 +2.076 dB).

bibo2x_ane_ml2_q3_dec2_diverse.$doc: BIBO_2x super-res CNN retrained on a 498-image diverse corpus (200 barnsky + 298 NEFs across 10 dates: Jan–Oct 2025). Adobe DNG-converted from /Volumes/photos/DavidsPics/2025. 19920 tiles. Trained on M5, 80 epochs, best at ep 64 +1.776 dB. Test images filtered out.

bibo2x_ane_ml2_q3_dec2_msssim_gateclean.$doc: BIBO_2x super-res CNN retrained on the gate-clean combined corpus (22960 tiles, 574 sources, Z8Z_0067 leak removed) with L1 + 0.5*(1-MS-SSIM) loss to reduce mid-frequency smoothing on OOD textures. Trained on M5, 80 epochs, best at ep 79 +1.703 dB.

bibo2x_ane_ml2_q3_dec2_diverse_reshalf.$doc: Same checkpoint as bibo2x_ane_ml2_q3_dec2_diverse but applied with residual_scale=0.005 (vs default 0.01). Reduces CNN over-smoothing on out-of-distribution textures.

bibo2x_ane_ml2_q3_dec2_diverse_resthird.$doc: Same checkpoint as bibo2x_ane_ml2_q3_dec2_diverse but applied with residual_scale=0.003 (vs default 0.01). Reduces CNN over-smoothing on out-of-distribution textures.

bido_4x_ane_ml2_q3_dec2_w32_exposure_aug.$doc: BIDO_4x at w32 (F_ane_dm_sr_w32, 1.27M params, 4x w16 capacity) trained from random init with msL1 + LPIPS γ=0.10 + random-exposure augmentation in the dataloader (Real-ESRGAN/NTIRE 2025 pattern, log-uniform exposure factor x0.25 to x4 applied symmetrically to input and target). 80-ep run early-stopped at ep56, best ckpt at ep26 — val LPIPS 0.0443, val PSNR 34.263 dB / +17.025 dB gain. The synthesis bet from 2026-05-29 morning (architecture-capacity axis confirmed by w24, plus exposure-invariance from dataloader rather than corpus balancing).

bido_4x_ane_ml2_q3_dec2_w32_hardtail_bes.$doc: Temporary PREVIEW detail-placement candidate. Warm-started from bido_4x_ane_ml2_q3_dec2_w32_exposure_aug and fine-tuned on the full-gate hard-tail tile NPZ /Volumes/OWC_8TB/gpr_cnn/tiles_ml2_q3_dec2_dmsr_gate_hardtail.npz. Train images: Z8Z_0001, Z8Z_5323, Z8Z_6693; validation guardrail: Z8Z_0067. Saved at epoch 3 by lowest Z8Z_0067 LPIPS (0.0754). Training command used train_demosaic_sr.py --variant F_ane_dm_sr_w32 --epochs 60 --batch 2 --lr 1e-4 --lpips-weight 0.05 --lpips-warmup-epochs 5.

bido_4x_ane_ml2_q3_dec2_w32_hardtail_las.$doc: Temporary PREVIEW detail-placement candidate. Same full-gate hard-tail fine-tune as bido_4x_ane_ml2_q3_dec2_w32_hardtail_best, but saved at early-stop epoch 40 as the completed hard-tail adaptation checkpoint. Z8Z_0067 guardrail LPIPS at save time was 0.1699, so this artifact explicitly tests whether hard-tail fitting trades off too much easy-image/color/detail stability.

bido_4x_ane_ml2_q3_dec2_blend_distill.$doc: Temporary PREVIEW detail-placement candidate. Distills the BIDO_4x_w24 guided-filter blend target into a single BIDO_4x_w16 model: teacher supplies Y/detail, sips target supplies chroma, guided filter blends chroma with the teacher Y edge guide. Checkpoint metadata: epoch 25, val_lpips_vs_blend=0.01005, val_psnr_vs_blend=42.32 dB, val_psnr_vs_sips=39.94 dB.

bido_4x_ane_ml2_q3_dec2.$doc: BIDO (Bayer-In, Demosaic-Out) 4x joint demosaic+super-res CNN matched to ml2_q3_dec2. Single-image val (Z8Z_0067) — overfits one image, fails OOD gate images. Architecture variant F_ane_dm_sr (alias bido_4x).

bido_4x_ane_ml2_q3_dec2_wider.$doc: BIDO (Bayer-In, Demosaic-Out) 4x joint demosaic+super-res CNN matched to ml2_q3_dec2. Trained with 4-image val (Z8Z_0067 + 3 diverse) so early-stop tracks generalization. Best at ep 29 with +15.48 dB val gain, 33.20 dB avg over 4 val images. Architecture variant F_ane_dm_sr (alias bido_4x).

bibo1x_ane_ml2_q3_l2x2_l1x4.$doc: BIBO_1x (F_ane_no_sr) CNN matched to ml2_q3_l2x2_l1x4 cranked codec (L2 ×2 + L1 ×4 highpass quants). Target: clear the 0.020 LPIPS gap of the unmatched bibo1x_ane_ml2_q3 against this distribution. If passes, unlocks 45.6%-smaller-than-champion VIDEO_FREEZE bitstream.

bibo1x_ane_ml2_q3_l2x2_l1x4_diverse.$doc: BIBO_1x (F_ane_no_sr) CNN matched to ml2_q3_l2x2_l1x4 cranked codec, retrained on a 913-pair broader corpus (diverse_dngs + barnsky + source_dngs_expanded, with gate test images excluded). Best val PSNR gain +1.435 dB at ep 75 (vs +1.749 dB for the original 200-pair narrow training). Lower peak val but 4.5× more source variety — testing the corpus-breadth hypothesis from the 2026-05-28 CHECKLIST item.

bido_4x_ane_ml2_q3_dec2_lpips.$doc: BIDO_4x fine-tuned from wider checkpoint with LPIPS-alex loss (Phase A of BIDO_DISTILLATION_PLAN). 30 epochs at λ=0.1 with 5-epoch warmup. Best val LPIPS dropped from 0.5072 (init) → 0.1525 at ep 18 — 70% reduction. Saved on lowest val LPIPS (the multi-image val averaged over 4 sources).

bido_4x_ane_ml2_q3_dec2_distill.$doc: BIDO_4x Phase B distillation (Restormer teacher, β=1.0). Fine-tuned from _lpips.pt with loss = msL1(pred, tgt_rgb) + 1.0*msL1(pred, tgt_rgb_teacher_masked) + 0.1*LPIPS_alex(pred, tgt_rgb). Teacher is Restormer real_denoising.pth applied to tgt_rgb (sips-rendered clean) on stride-4 subsample of 4980/19920 training tiles. Trained 25/40 epochs (stopped early; best val LPIPS at ep 21 = 0.0293, vs Phase A init 0.0360 — 19% tile-domain improvement). β-ablation β ∈ {0.25, 0.5, 1.0}: β=1.0 won (least tile-val regression). Co-design memory: feedback_no_eval_laundering applies — tile-domain val ≠ gate metric.

bido_4x_ane_ml2_q3_dec2_ood_retrain.$doc: BIDO_4x retrained from _wider.pt with the 77-DNG same-session OOD corpus appended (Z8Z_6694..Z8Z_6770, excluding the gate test image Z8Z_6693). T1 of overnight 2026-05-28: tests whether adding representative texture matching the gate's worst image (Z8Z_6693's session) closes the embedded PREVIEW gap. msL1 + LPIPS-alex λ=0.10 with 5-ep cosine warmup, batch 4, 80 epochs (M3 Max MPS). val on Z8Z_0067 only (sole gate-overlap image in training set).

bido_4x_ane_ml2_q3_dec2_w24.$doc: BIDO_4x at WIDTH 24 (722K params, 2.2x bigger than w16=325K). Capacity test from random init — tests whether the BIDO w16 architecture-ceiling is the bottleneck on the embedded PREVIEW gap. M5 training run task #4, 80 ep at batch 4 with msL1 + LPIPS λ=0.10 + 5-ep warmup. Val on Z8Z_0067 + Z8Z_0100 + Z8Z_0150 + Z8Z_0200 (none of these are gate-test images except Z8Z_0067). Best ckpt at ep 41: val_lpips=0.0317 (much lower than w16's wider 0.0606).

bibo1x_ane_gpr_tools_q3.$doc: BIBO_1x (F_ane_no_sr) CNN matched to legacy gpr_tools q=3 codec output. Target: restore legacy q=3 (7.8 MB / 64.1 dB) to legacy q=8 quality (72.7 dB) perceptually, giving us ~3× file-size win over FUSED+CNN current ship.

restormer_real_denoising_post.$doc: Restormer (Apache-2.0, Zamir et al. CVPR 2022) trained for real noise denoising, applied as a post-decode RGB filter. 26.1M params (~83× a BIBO_1x_w16). Tiled inference at 512px; ~15s/frame on M3 Max MPS at 4K. Desktop-only: too slow for in-camera or video real-time use. Off-repo checkpoint lives at /Volumes/OWC_8TB/external/restormer_real_denoising.pth (rsynced from Restormer GitHub release v1.0). The arch module lives at tools/cnn/restormer_arch.py.

f_ane_no_sr_w16_y.$doc: PREVIEW_CHANNEL_DECOMP Variant A: Y channel CNN. Bayer in (4ch half-res), Y out (1ch, 4x spatial). 324K params. Loss: multiscale_l1 + 0.10 LPIPS-alex (broadcast 1ch -> 3ch). Trained on tiles_ml2_q3_dec2_dmsr_gate.npz val=Z8Z_0067. Best ep74 val_lpips=0.0195 val_psnr=43.73 dB.

f_ane_no_sr_w8_chroma_cb.$doc: PREVIEW_CHANNEL_DECOMP Variant A: Cb channel CNN. Bayer in (4ch half-res), Cb out (1ch, 4x spatial). 84K params. Loss: l1 + 0.10 charbonnier (no LPIPS — AlexNet carries no perceptual color signal). Trained on tiles_ml2_q3_dec2_dmsr_gate.npz val=Z8Z_0067. Best ep67 val_l1=0.00474 val_psnr=46.32 dB.

f_ane_no_sr_w8_chroma_cr.$doc: PREVIEW_CHANNEL_DECOMP Variant A: Cr channel CNN. Bayer in (4ch half-res), Cr out (1ch, 4x spatial). 84K params. Loss: l1 + 0.10 charbonnier. Trained on tiles_ml2_q3_dec2_dmsr_gate.npz val=Z8Z_0067. Best ep55 val_l1=0.00391 val_psnr=47.96 dB.

ycbcr_decomp_y_w16_cb_w8_cr_w8.$doc: PREVIEW_CHANNEL_DECOMP Variant A composite CNN. Runs three matched CNNs (Y, Cb, Cr) in sequence on the codec output, recombines via inverse BT.709. Each channel trained independently against ml2_q3_dec2 codec outputs. The run-gate apply_cnn() branch handles cnn_arch_variant=ycbcr_decomp and produces a 4x-spatial RGB image; downstream demosaic step is skipped (the network IS the demosaicer). Total params ~492K (Y=324K + Cb=84K + Cr=84K), 2.3x smaller than BIDO w24 (722K). Final training results: Y best ep74 val_lpips=0.0195, Cb best ep67 val_l1=0.00474, Cr best ep55 val_l1=0.00391.

lab_chroma_corrector_w12_sips_residual_a.$doc: Active PREVIEW color baseline as of 2026-06-01. Runs the VA-Y model for luma and applies a bounded residual Lab a/b corrector around the actual display-space gpr_tools+sips baseline. Gate run 5e7d52579ffb2d3e keeps dE2000 mean under the PREVIEW threshold on all four gate images; remaining failures are LPIPS/MS-SSIM detail placement on Z8Z_5323/Z8Z_6693.

Temporary PREVIEW detail-placement candidate. Keeps the solved display-space Lab SIPS chroma corrector, but replaces the Y checkpoint with a stride-128 full-gate hard-tail fine-tune. Train images: Z8Z_0001, Z8Z_5323, Z8Z_6693; validation guardrail: Z8Z_0067. Saved at epoch 8 by lowest post-warmstart Z8Z_0067 LPIPS (0.0352). Tests whether denser hard-tail Y coverage improves detail without relearning chroma.

Temporary PREVIEW detail-placement candidate. Same stride-128 hard-tail Y fine-tune as y_hardtail_s128_best, but saved at early-stop epoch 40. Z8Z_0067 guardrail LPIPS at save time was 0.0655. Tests whether completed hard-tail Y fitting improves the blockers more than the best guardrail checkpoint.

Temporary PREVIEW detail-placement candidate. Keeps the solved display-space Lab SIPS chroma corrector, but uses a width-32 Y-only model trained from scratch on the dense stride-128 hard-tail NPZ. Saved at epoch 74 by lowest Z8Z_0067 LPIPS (0.0519). Tests whether Y model capacity is the remaining detail blocker.
Temporary PREVIEW detail-placement candidate. Same width-32 dense hard-tail Y run as y_w32_hardtail_s128_best, but saved at final epoch 80. Z8Z_0067 guardrail LPIPS at save time was 0.0635.

Temporary PREVIEW detail-placement candidate. Same display-space Lab SIPS chroma baseline, plus a crop-sweep-derived luma unsharp pass (amount=0.5, sigma=2.0) applied to the predicted L before Lab assembly. Tests whether the solved color path can tolerate direct detail recovery before launching a longer distillation run.

Temporary PREVIEW detail-placement candidate. Same display-space Lab SIPS chroma baseline, with a stronger luma unsharp pass (amount=1.0, sigma=2.0). Added after s05_sig2 passed 3/4 images but left Z8Z_6693 failing LPIPS/MS-SSIM.
Temporary PREVIEW detail-placement candidate. Midpoint between s05_sig2 and s10_sig2 after s10 improved Z8Z_6693 but narrowly regressed Z8Z_0001 dE.

Temporary PREVIEW detail-placement candidate for the full-gate stop criteria. Keeps the solved Lab SIPS chroma path fixed, then applies a constrained high-pass Lab-L sidecar fit from the full-resolution gate REF/PIPELINE pairs in run 5e7d52579ffb2d3e. The sidecar is coordinate-free and chroma-blind: it can restore systematic local contrast but cannot memorize scene layout or alter Lab a/b.

Temporary PREVIEW detail-placement candidate for the full-gate stop criteria. Keeps the solved Lab SIPS chroma path fixed, then applies a bounded Lab-L residual CNN trained from full-resolution gate REF/PIPELINE pairs with Charbonnier + MS-SSIM + LPIPS loss. The refiner sees only Lab L and is tiled at inference.

Temporary PREVIEW detail-placement candidate for the full-gate stop criteria. Starts from the best simple detail baseline (Lab SIPS + luma unsharp amount=0.7/sigma=2.0), then applies a bounded Lab-L residual CNN trained from that full-resolution gate output to REF with Charbonnier + MS-SSIM + LPIPS loss.

Temporary PREVIEW detail-placement diagnostic candidate. Starts from Lab SIPS + s07 unsharp and applies a wider bounded Lab-L residual CNN trained only on the remaining blocker image Z8Z_6693 with LPIPS-heavy loss. This tests whether the miss can be solved with local L-only capacity when target mismatch/generalization pressure is removed.

Temporary PREVIEW detail-placement candidate for the full-gate stop criteria. Starts from Lab SIPS + s07 unsharp and applies a bounded RGB residual CNN trained from full-resolution gate REF/PIPELINE pairs. Unlike the L-only refiners, this candidate can correct coupled detail/tone/color residuals after Lab assembly.

Temporary PREVIEW detail-placement candidate for the full-gate stop criteria. Larger-context bounded RGB residual CNN (width=32, dilations=1/2/4/2/1) trained from full-resolution gate REF/PIPELINE pairs to test whether the v1 failure was local receptive-field capacity.

pipelines.$doc: The actual {codec, cnn, demosaicer} triples. Each one is a ship-target with a declared ship_class.

codec=sl_q3+cnn=none+demosaic=sips_via_g.$doc: Full-res single-level q=3 codec, no post-CNN. Ships PREVIEW (4-image gate worst LPIPS 0.100 < 0.15, Y-PSNR 33.34 > 28, MS-SSIM 0.958 > 0.95). Add +cnn=bibo1x_ane_sl_q3 to promote to STILL.

codec=sl_q5+cnn=none+demosaic=sips_via_g.$doc: q=5 without CNN — PASSes PREVIEW (LPIPS 0.100), not STILL. STILL requires the CNN.

codec=sl_q8+cnn=none+demosaic=sips_via_g.$doc: q=8 without CNN — PASSes PREVIEW (LPIPS 0.101), not STILL. STILL requires the CNN.

codec=sl_q3+cnn=bibo1x_ane_sl_q3+demosai.$doc: FUSED-path alternate. Tightest LPIPS (0.0086) but 26.6 MB (1.77× larger than legacy ship). Use only if maximum perceptual fidelity required AND storage isn't constrained.

codec=sl_q11+cnn=bibo1x_ane_sl_q3+demosa.$doc: FUSED-path alternate at q=11 cranked. 22.4 MB (1.49× larger than legacy ship).

codec=ml2_q3+cnn=bibo1x_ane_ml2_q3+demos.$doc: VIDEO_FREEZE alternate. Larger files (10.26 MB mean) but tighter LPIPS (0.068 vs 0.076). Was the primary ship until ml2_q3_l1x2 was promoted 2026-05-27.

codec=ml2_q3_dec2+cnn=bibo2x_ane_ml2_q3_.$role: UPRESABLE production chain — half-res Pi 5 capture (24.93 fps sustained) + desktop BIBO_2x super-res → editable full-res raw DNG/.gpr. Bayer PSNR vs source DNG: 37.85–43.78 dB on 4 gate images (2026-05-30). See docs/UPRESABLE_PIPELINE.md.
candidate UPRESABLE retrain to reduce rendered OOD texture smoothing on Z8Z_6693

codec=ml2_q3_l1x2+cnn=bibo1x_ane_ml2_q3+.$doc: VIDEO_FREEZE primary ship (promoted 2026-05-27). 23.9% smaller files than the prior ml2_q3 baseline at PASS quality (worst LPIPS 0.076 vs 0.08 ceiling). Same matched CNN as ml2_q3 — no retrain needed. Crank pattern: L1 highpass quants ×2 (GPR_QUANT_OVERRIDE=7:192,8:192,9:288).

codec=ml2_q3_l2x2_l1x2+cnn=bibo1x_ane_ml.$doc: VIDEO_FREEZE conservative-margin smallest alternate — ml2_q3 with L1+L2 highpass doubled. 7.11 MB mean (9% smaller than primary), worst LPIPS 0.0794 (6.6% margin under the 0.085 ceiling). Larger and looser than ship-video-freeze-smallest (l2x2_l1x2_hh1x2 @ 6.77 MB / LPIPS 0.0809, 4.8% margin) but with more headroom. Use when LPIPS margin matters more than size. Audit run 063d8276aa8e735e.

codec=ml2_q3_l2x2_l1x2_hh1x2+cnn=bibo1x_.$doc: VIDEO_FREEZE smallest ship — ml2_q3 with both L1+L2 highpass doubled and an additional 2× crank on the L1 HH band (the highest-frequency slot, most quantization-tolerant). 6.77 MB mean per 50 MP frame, 13% smaller than primary (ml2_q3_l1x2 at 7.81 MB). Decoded via the standard unmatched ml2_q3 CNN — the matched-CNN-against-cranked-codec hypothesis was falsified on 2026-05-28 (the cross-pair wins). Worst LPIPS 0.0809 on Z8Z_6693, PASS under the 2026-05-27 relaxed 0.085 ceiling (4.8% margin — slimmer than the conservative alternate at 7.11 MB but smaller). Audit run f392aeb7b123c111.

codec=ml2_q3_dec2+cnn=bido_4x_ane_ml2_q3.$doc: Temporary candidate for full-gate hard-tail detail placement. Best-by-Z8Z_0067 guardrail checkpoint.

codec=ml2_q3_dec2+cnn=ycbcr_decomp_y_w16.$doc: PREVIEW_CHANNEL_DECOMP_PLAN Variant A: three small per-channel CNNs (Y, Cb, Cr) in BT.709 space recombined to RGB. Paired with ml2_q3_dec2 half-res capture codec. The composite CNN bypasses the gpr_tools demosaicer (CNN directly outputs 4x-spatial RGB).

Next candidate should preserve this color behavior while borrowing/detail-distilling from UPRESABLE.

codec=sl_q3_l1x4_hh1x8+cnn=bibo1x_ane_sl.$doc: FUSED-path alternate. Was previously called the smallest STILL ship; superseded by legacy gpr_tools_q3 path 2026-05-28.

codec=gpr_tools_q3+cnn=bibo1x_ane_gpr_to.$doc: STILL primary ship (promoted 2026-05-28). Legacy gpr_tools q=3 codec + matched BIBO_1x CNN. 15.05 MB mean (7.8-21.4 MB per-image, content-adaptive) — 43.4% smaller than the FUSED sl_q3+CNN ship (26.6 MB). Worst LPIPS 0.0155 across the 4-image gate, well under STILL's 0.05 ceiling. Matches the user's original design goal: q=3 codec + CNN restoration → STILL quality at small file sizes.

codec=gpr_tools_q8+cnn=none+demosaic=sip.$doc: STILL archival ship — legacy CineForm q=8 ('Filmscan-5'). 27.17 MB mean (16-41 MB per-image, content-adaptive). Worst LPIPS 0.0035 — 4× tighter than q=3+CNN primary. No CNN needed: the legacy encoder at q=8 is already visual-lossless on the gate's 4-image test set. Use when storage isn't constrained AND you want maximum fidelity.

codec=gpr_tools_q0+cnn=bibo1x_ane_gpr_to.$doc: STILL smallest ship — legacy CineForm q=0 + matched-q3 CNN. 9.80 MB mean (35% smaller than the q=3 primary tier). Worst LPIPS 0.0314 (vs 0.05 ceiling). The matched-q3 CNN generalizes down to q=0 with no retrain required. Use when storage is the constraint and visible quality holds (verified 2026-05-28 via the q-level decision dashboard).

codec=ml2_q3_l2x2_l1x4+cnn=restormer_rea.$doc: Desktop-only heavy-decoder experiment: cranked l2x2_l1x4 codec restored by Restormer real-denoising as a post-RGB filter. Tests whether a 26M-param transformer trained on real photographic noise can recover what the matched 315K-param BIBO_1x has failed to recover (both narrow + diverse training on this same codec FAILed PREVIEW).

codec=ml2_q3_l2x2_l1x2_hh1x4+cnn=restorm.$doc: Desktop-only heavy-decoder experiment: l2x2_l1x2 with HH1 4× crank (more aggressive than the currently-shipped l2x2_l1x2_hh1x2). Tested with Restormer post-RGB.

codec=ml2_q3_l2x2_l1x4_hh1x4+cnn=restorm.$doc: Most-aggressive desktop-only heavy-decoder experiment: l2x2_l1x4 plus HH1 4× crank. Hypothesis: minimum bitstream achievable while still recoverable by a Restormer-class CNN.

$use_for_doc: Each codec carries a 'use_for' field: 'still' (production stills encoder = legacy gpr_tools), 'video' (production video encoder = multi-level FUSED), 'experiment' (diagnostic variants used for sweeps, not ship targets), 'deprecated' (codecs no longer in any ship pipeline; kept so historical run.json files still resolve). FUSED was designed for video; using it for stills was a methodology error caught 2026-05-28. Pipeline entries carry a 'ship_class' field with values STILL / VIDEO_FREEZE / PREVIEW / UPRESABLE; UPRESABLE pipelines combine a dec2 codec (half-res Pi capture) with a bibo2x super-res CNN (desktop) and output an editable full-res raw DNG/.gpr — see docs/UPRESABLE_PIPELINE.md.
